description: This file defines a React component 'EchartsTreemap' for rendering a treemap visualization using Echarts within the Superset project. It handles cross-filter interactions, context menu events, and integrates with Superset's data formatting and filtering utilities.

methods.name: getCrossFilterDataMask
methods.description: Generates data mask for cross-filtering based on selected tree path and label mappings.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles updates to data mask when a treemap segment is clicked.
